newsitem.title: USA: Genta says Adams resigns as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Genta says Adams resigns as chairman.

text.p: Genta Inc said Thomas Adams, who co-founded Genta in 1989, has resigned from the board and as chairman and chief executive officer of the company.
The company also said Michael Weiss, senior managing director of Paramount Capital Inc, was elected to the board of Genta and as interim chairman.
The company said John Dee and John Oyler will assist the company as an interim management team during this transitional period while it seeks a full-time chief executive officer.
